elk.system_summary: Preference points decide first-choice licenses, highest points first, with a random hybrid draw (applicants with 5+ points) for hunt codes that took 10+ resident points the prior year.

elk.lose_points_if: You draw your first-choice license (including a hybrid license), or you go 10 consecutive years without applying for or holding an elk license.
elk.group_points_rule: Unlimited group size; group draws at the point level of the member with the fewest points; groups not allowed for hybrid codes.

elk.system_summary: Elk permits and Elk B licenses use squared bonus points (random draw, points^2 + 1 entries); nonresident Big Game and Elk Combination licenses (general elk) use preference points: 75% to most points (max 3), 25% random to zero-point applicants.
elk.points_name: bonus points (permits/B licenses); preference points (nonresident combination licenses)

allocation.pool: Combination license: preference point holders, most points first
allocation.note: Nonresident Big Game and Elk Combination share a 17,000 quota; max 3 preference points.

allocation.pool: Combination license: random among applicants with zero preference points
allocation.note: Only applicants holding no preference points.

allocation.pool: Elk permits and Elk B: weighted random draw
allocation.note: Bonus points squared, first choice only; nonresidents limited to 10% of permit quota; up to 15% landowner preference.

elk.weighting: bonus points squared + 1 entry (e.g., 3 points = 10 chances); only used in a year you elect to buy a bonus point
elk.nonresident_quota: Nonresidents limited to, but not guaranteed, 10% of elk permit quotas by state law; nonresident general elk via 17,000 Big Game/Elk Combination quota.

resident.license_prereq: Conservation license ($8) + base hunting license ($10) + general elk license ($20) to use a permit
resident.notes: Bonus point $2 when elected at application; $15 point-only July 1 - Sept 30. No preference points. Elk B drawing $25. Application fee value is the elk permit fee; FWP also lists a $5 nonrefundable application fee per license/permit.

nonresident.license_prereq: Conservation license ($10) + base hunting license ($50) + Elk or Big Game Combination (held or applied for)
nonresident.notes: Bonus point $20 at application, $25 point-only July 1 - Sept 30. Preference point $100 at application or July 1 - Dec 31 (max 3; outfitter clients may buy a second $100 point, license then valid only with an outfitter). Elk Combination $1,112; Big Game Combination $1,312; Elk B $270 plus $5 application fee. AIS pass $7.50 (16+).

elk.point_only_option: Bonus point only: July 1 - Sept 30 ($15 R / $25 NR) if you did not apply for that license type. Nonresident preference point only: July 1 - Dec 31 ($100) if not applying for a combination license.
elk.lose_points_if: Bonus points: you draw your first choice in a year you elected a bonus point, or lose privileges by court action (no expiry for skipping years). Preference points: you draw a combination license, or you hold points and skip the next combination drawing.
elk.group_points_rule: Parties of 2-5; bonus points averaged and rounded to nearest whole number; preference points averaged to three decimals; one entry per party.

allocation.pool: New Mexico residents

brown_bear.system_summary: Kodiak and some other brown bear hunts are drawing lotteries; many others are registration permit or general season hunts.

allocation.pool: random lottery per hunt
allocation.note: No points; each application is one entry; up to 6 applications per species (individual + party), repeats of the same hunt allowed.

brown_bear.nonresident_quota: Hunt by hunt; Kodiak relative-guided nonresidents capped at 4 per season, 8 per regulatory year; guided nonresidents limited to one application per hunt on Kodiak.

resident.license_prereq: Alaska resident hunting license (not required for residents 17 and younger)
resident.notes: Resident brown bear tag $25 in some locations.

nonresident.notes: Locking tag $1000 bought before hunting (not to apply). Guide or resident relative (19+, second-degree kindred) required.

brown_bear.waiting_period: One drawing permit per species per year; fall Kodiak permit winners cannot draw a Kodiak permit the next spring.
brown_bear.group_points_rule: party of two shares one draw number; whole application invalid if either member ineligible; two nonresidents with a resident relative may not apply as a party

tiers.example_hunts: Registration permit hunts (no draw)
tiers.note: Undersubscribed or low-demand hunts; some permits go unclaimed. No points involved.

tiers.example_hunts: Non-Kodiak DB hunts
tiers.note: Odds = permits / applications each year; check last year's results on the back page of the supplement.

tiers.example_hunts: Kodiak DB100/DB200 series
tiers.note: Few permits, many applicants; long odds every year with no way to build points.

elk.system_summary: A few elk drawing hunts (DE series) run as pure lotteries.

allocation.pool: random lottery per hunt
allocation.note: No points; each application is one entry; up to 6 applications per species (individual + party), repeats of the same hunt allowed.

resident.license_prereq: Alaska resident hunting license (not required for residents 17 and younger)

nonresident.notes: Locking tag $600 bought before hunting (not to apply).

elk.waiting_period: One drawing permit per species per regulatory year; cannot be awarded the exact same drawing hunt two years in a row (except undersubscribed permits).
elk.group_points_rule: party of two shares one draw number; whole application invalid if either member ineligible; two nonresidents with a resident relative may not apply as a party

tiers.note: Undersubscribed or low-demand hunts; some permits go unclaimed. No points involved.

tiers.example_hunts: DE hunts
tiers.note: Odds = permits / applications each year; check last year's results on the back page of the supplement.
Few permits, many applicants; long odds every year with no way to build points.

deer.system_summary: Sitka black-tailed deer are hunted on general season harvest tickets; no deer drawing hunts appear in the 2026-27 supplement.

resident.license_prereq: Alaska resident hunting license (not required for residents 17 and younger)

nonresident.notes: Locking tag $300 bought before hunting (not to apply).

tiers.example_hunts: General season Sitka blacktail (Units 2, 4, 6, 8 etc.)
tiers.note: No draw; harvest ticket (nonresidents also buy a $300 deer locking tag).
